records.title: VisualThink-VLA: Visual Intermediate Reasoning for Effective and Low-Latency Vision-Language-Action Policies

records.title: Anytime Training with Schedule-Free Spectral Optimization
records.reason: The method combines schedule-free optimization with spectral preconditioning and evaluates training convergence/quality. It is a training optimizer and does not report inference execution, serving memory, or latency improvements.
